topic: Renting an Extra Parking Spot from the Building

script.title: PARKING SPOT NINE
script.scene_zh: 管理處辦公室 · 租停車位
script.story_hook: A faded line, a small truck, and a weekend guest.
script.intro_zh: 一條褪色的停車線、一輛小卡車，還有週末要來的客人。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we rent a garage parking spot. Listen for fees, rules, and favors.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天要租一個車庫停車位。留意費用、規定與互相幫忙的說法。
script.outro: One spot, one pass, one happy truck. Listen again and collect the phrases.
script.outro_zh: 一個車位、一張訪客證，還有一輛開心的小卡車。再聽一遍，把實用說法收進口袋。
script.practice_intro_en: Now say each line out loud with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請跟我一起把每句大聲說出來。
script.title_quote: Tell the truck I said hi
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his early forties with salt-and-pepper wavy hair brushed forward, a neat gray beard, a brown quilted vest over a red plaid flannel shirt, and a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her mid thirties with straight blonde hair in a high ponytail, a coral blouse, a laminated ID badge on a green lanyard, small hoop earrings, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, it's Doug from twelve B, got a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪts dʌɡ fɹəm twɛlv bi ɡɑt ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是十二B的Doug，有空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! What can I help you find today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs wʌt kən aɪ hɛlp ju faɪnd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然有！今天想找房務幫什麼忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A parking spot in the garage, if one exists.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpɑɹkɪŋ spɑt ɪn ðə ɡəˈɹɑʒ ɪf wʌn ɪɡˈzɪsts/
dialogue.zh: 車庫的停車位，不知道還有沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great timing, we just freed up one yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈtaɪmɪŋ wi dʒʌst frid ʌp wʌn ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛巧，昨天才空出一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky me! Um, which spot is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki mi ʌm wɪtʃ spɑt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我真幸運！嗯，是哪一個車位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's number nine, on the upper level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈnʌmbɚ naɪn ɑn ði ˈʌpɚ ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 九號，在樓上那一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one near the stairwell?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌn nɪɹ ðə ˈstɛɹˌwɛl/
dialogue.zh: 就是靠近樓梯間的那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, close to the elevator too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kloʊz tə ði ˈɛləˌveɾɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，離電梯也很近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's the space? I drive a small truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊz ðə speɪs aɪ dɹaɪv ə smɔːl tɹʌk/
dialogue.zh: 位子寬嗎？我開的是一輛小卡車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The truck's fine, the spot is generous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɹʌks faɪn ðə spɑt ɪz ˈdʒɛnəɹəs/
dialogue.zh: 卡車沒問題，那個位子很寬綽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, generous is a good word for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈdʒɛnəɹəs ɪz ə ɡʊd wɚd fɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 「寬綽」這個形容用得真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lines are faded, but it's a real spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪnz ɑɹ ˈfeɪdɪd bʌt ɪts ə ɹɪl spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 停車線是褪色了，但空間貨真價實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take faded lines, my truck is patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ˈfeɪdɪd laɪnz maɪ tɹʌk ɪz ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 車線舊沒關係，我的卡車很沉得住氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it's nice to talk to a truck owner.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts naɪs tə tɔk tə ə tɹʌk ˈoʊnəɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，跟卡車主人聊天真愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what's the monthly fee on spot nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌts ðə ˈmʌnθli fi ɑn spɑt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那九號車位每個月的費用是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fifty-five, charged with your rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɪfti faɪv tʃɑɹd wɪð jɔɹ ɹɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 五十五塊，跟租金一起收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty-five... and is that with the gate remote?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti faɪv ænd ɪz ðæt wɪð ðə ɡeɪt ɹɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 五十五……這樣包含大門遙控器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One remote comes free, replacements are twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɹɪˈmoʊt kʌmz fri ɹɪˈpleɪsmənts ɑɹ ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 附一個遙控器，補辦要二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty for a little clicker, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fɚ ə ˈlɪɾɚ ˈklɪkəɚ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一個小遙控器要二十塊，天啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, the batteries hate us all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ðə ˈbæɾəɹiz heɪt ʌs ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，電池好像在跟所有人作對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Um, can I park anywhere before it starts?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ʌm kæn aɪ pɑɹk ˈɛniˌwɛɹ bɪˈfɔɹ ɪt stɑɹts/
dialogue.zh: 好吧。嗯，在車位生效之前我能隨便停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can't, that's how tickets happen here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kænt ðæts haʊ ˈtɪkɪts ˈhæpən hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不能，這裡的罰單就是這樣來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, my truck behaves, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd maɪ tɹʌk bɪˈheɪvz ˈmoʊstli/
dialogue.zh: 了解，我的卡車很守規矩，大致上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mostly is a brave word.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈmoʊstli ɪz ə bɹeɪv wɚd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，「大致上」三個字說得挺大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the real reason I came: weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ɹiəl ˈɹizən aɪ keɪmd ˈwiːkˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我真正想問的是週末。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekends? The garage is quiet on weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwiːkˌɛndz ðə ɡəˈɹɑʒ ɪz ˈkwaɪət ɑn ˈwiːkˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 週末？週末車庫很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, my brother visits with a bigger truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈbɹʌðəɚ ˈvɪzɪts wɪð ə ˈbɪɡəɚ tɹʌk/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣，我弟弟要來，開更大的卡車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's a visitor situation, we have passes.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ə ˈvɪzɪtəɚ ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən wi hæv ˈpæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那就是訪客的情況，我們有訪客證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pass? Is that free, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pæs ɪz ðæt fri ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 訪客證？老實說，那個免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free, but only five passes a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fri bʌt ˈoʊnli faɪv ˈpæsəz ə jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 免費，但一年只能拿五張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five is plenty, he visits in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɪz ˈplɛnti hi ˈvɪzɪts ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 五張綽綽有餘，他六月來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does he park overnight, or just for a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi pɑɹk ˌoʊvəɚˈnaɪt ɔɹ dʒʌst fɚ ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他要過夜嗎，還是只停一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two nights, maybe three, if the fishing's good.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naɪts ˈmeɪbi θɹi ɪf ðə ˈfɪʃɪŋz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 兩晚，也許三晚，如果釣魚順利的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fishing? Your brother is my kind of guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪʃɪŋ jɔɹ ˈbɹʌðəɚ ɪz maɪ kaɪnd əv ɡɛst/
dialogue.zh: 釣魚？你弟弟是我喜歡的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll bring smoked trout, I guarantee it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil bɹɪŋ smoʊt traʊt aɪ ˌɡæɹənˈti ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他會帶燻魚來，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sold. Send me his plate number by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld sɛnd mi hɪz pleɪt ˈnʌmbəɚ baɪ ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。星期五之前把他的車牌傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plates? Um, his plate is Delta, seven-four-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪts ʌm hɪz pleɪt ɪz ˈdɛltə ˈsɛvən fɔɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 車牌？嗯，他的車牌是 Delta，七四二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, D-742, I'll print the pass now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt di ˈsɛvən fɔɹ tu aɪl pɹɪnt ðə pæs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，D-742，我現在就把證印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're fast. Where does he actually park?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ fæst wɛɹ dʌz hi ˈæktʃuəli pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 你真快。那他實際上停哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The yellow visitor spots, the ones by the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈjɛloʊ ˈvɪzɪtəɚ spɑts ði wʌnz baɪ ðə pul/
dialogue.zh: 就是泳池旁那幾格黃色訪客位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, those yellow lines are for visitors?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðoʊz ˈjɛloʊ laɪnz ɑɹ fɔɹ ˈvɪzɪtəɚz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，那些黃線格位是給訪客的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, though not everyone reads the signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑɹ ðoʊ nɑt ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ɹidz ðə saɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過不是每個人都會去看標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! One more thing about spot nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ əˈbaʊt spɑt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！九號車位還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's on your mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts ɑn jɔɹ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ceiling low? My truck has a rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsilɪŋ loʊ maɪ tɹʌk hæz ə ɹæk/
dialogue.zh: 天花板低嗎？我卡車上有行李架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The upper level is tall, the rack fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌpəɚ ˈlɛvəl ɪz tɔl ðə ɹæk fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 上面那層挑得高，行李架放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the best news this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst nuz ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這一週最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, there's a catch: no oil leaks allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛɹz ə kætʃ noʊ ɔɪl liːks əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 先說好：不可以滴漏機油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The truck drips a little, like it's sweating.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɹʌk dɹɪps ə ˈlɪɾəɚ laɪk ɪts ˈswɛɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那台卡車會漏一點，像在流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use a drip mat, they're cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz ə dɹɪp mæt ðeɹ tʃip/
dialogue.zh: 那就鋪一塊接油墊，很便宜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mat, sure, I can survive a mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæt ʃʊɹ aɪ kæn sɚˈvaɪv ə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 墊子啊，好吧，應付一塊墊子還行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all must, spot nine has a long history.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔl mʌst spɑt naɪn hæz ə lɔŋ ˈhɪstəɹi/
dialogue.zh: 大家都得這樣，九號車位歷史悠久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, should I bring the truck a gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ ðə tɹʌk ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我該帶個見面禮給它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it clean, that's the only gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ɪt klin ðæts ði ˈoʊnli ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 把車洗乾淨開來，就是唯一的見面禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done deal. Remote pickup is Monday, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dil ɹɪˈmoʊt ˈpɪkˌʌp ɪz ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。遙控器星期一領取，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, nine at the desk, bring your ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt naɪn æt ðə dɛsk bɹɪŋ jɔɹ ˌaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 對，九點到櫃台，帶身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be there early, I'm always early.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bi ðɛɹ ˈɜɹli aɪm ˈɔlweɪz ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 我會很早到，我向來都很早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a red flag for a neighbor, just saying.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɹɛd flæɡ fɚ ə ˈneɪbəɚ dʒʌst ˈseɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對鄰居來說這算危險訊號喔，我隨便講講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Thanks for turning errands into a chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ θæŋks fɚ ˈtɜɹnɪŋ ɪˈɹændz ˈɪntə ə tʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！謝謝你把跑腿辦事變成一段聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, Doug. Tell the truck I said hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm dɑɡ tɛl ðə tɹʌk aɪ sɛd haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，Doug。也跟那台卡車說聲嗨。

script.youtube_title: 【車位怎麼租🚗】「也跟那台卡車說聲嗨」管理處租車位全過程🅿️🎧｜費用規則一次聽懂｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Renting a Parking Spot
script.youtube_title_en: "Tell the Truck I Said Hi" — Renting a Garage Parking Spot at the Office
script.youtube_description:
「也跟那台卡車說聲嗨」——到管理處租一個車庫停車位，到底會聊些什麼？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在大樓管理處的櫃台前。

你會聽到：開口問車位的開場句；月費、與租金合併收費、遙控器費用與遺失補辦的問法；車位線褪色、天花板高度、機油滴漏等實際細節；還有弟弟開卡車來過週末時，訪客證怎麼申請、車牌怎麼報。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦事的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、wow、honestly。聽完你就會用：What can I help you find、charged with your rent、Send me his plate number、that's how tickets happen。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先記住，腦袋自然就跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Tell the truck I said hi" — what actually happens when you walk into the leasing office to rent a parking spot? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the property management desk.

You will hear: opening the request politely, asking about monthly fees billed with rent, gate remote prices and replacements, faded lines, ceiling height and oil-leak rules, plus getting a visitor pass for a brother with a big truck and a fishing weekend.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the fillers Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, wow, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like What can I help you find, charged with your rent, and Send me his plate number.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
大樓車庫還有空車位嗎？月費怎麼算、遙控器要不要錢、訪客證怎麼申請，這些用英文到底要怎麼問？開卡車的人租車位，會不會要多回答幾個問題？

這一集帶大家走進管理處辦公室，聽住戶 Doug 跟 property manager 從九號車位一路聊到弟弟的週末訪客證，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🅿️ 問車位：A parking spot in the garage, if one exists.
💳 問費用：So what's the monthly fee on spot nine?
🚙 問細節：Is the ceiling low? My truck has a rack.
🎫 辦訪客證：Send me his plate number by Friday.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、wow 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這一趟管理處之行走完，下次你要辦任何社區事務，英文就會自己開口。

祝你也順利分到自己的九號車位。
